findings.rationale: The aws_security_group.admin resource in main.tf allows inbound TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the administrative shell to every IPv4 source.
The aws_security_group.db resource in main.tf allows inbound TCP port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the database engine to every IPv4 source.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The aws_s3_bucket_policy.trap in main.tf grants anonymous access, but aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.trap blocks public ACLs and public policies, containing the anonymous grant.
